summary: Iteration 28 - Social Features Testing. All 30 tests passed. New endpoints verified: user profile with friendship_status/stats/recent_visits, user search (excludes self), sent friend requests, reject friend request, remove friend, conversations with last_message/unread_count, visit privacy editing. Existing endpoints verified: feed, community-feed, leaderboard, friends, friends/pending.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/users/{user_id}/profile correctly returns friendship_status (none/friends/pending_sent/pending_received), stats with counts, and recent_visits list
GET /api/users/search correctly excludes current user from results and returns empty list for <2 char queries
GET /api/friends/sent uses $lookup to join user info - eliminates N+1 queries
GET /api/friends/pending uses $lookup to join user info - eliminates N+1 queries
GET /api/messages/conversations uses aggregation pipeline with batch fetch - eliminates N+1 queries
PUT /api/visits/{visit_id}/privacy correctly validates visibility values and updates both visits and activities collections
All existing endpoints (feed, community-feed, leaderboard, friends) continue to work after social features addition
context_for_next_testing_agent: Social features iteration 28 complete. All new endpoints verified: GET /api/users/{user_id}/profile (returns is_own_profile, friendship_status, stats, recent_visits), GET /api/users/search?q=X (excludes self, returns user_id/name/username/picture/bio), GET /api/friends/sent (sent requests with $lookup), POST /api/friends/{id}/reject (404 for invalid), DELETE /api/friends/{id} (404 for invalid), GET /api/messages/conversations (premium only, returns friend/last_message/unread_count), PUT /api/visits/{visit_id}/privacy (validates visibility, updates both visits and activities). Existing endpoints verified working: /api/feed, /api/community-feed, /api/leaderboard (entries have user_id for profile navigation), /api/friends, /api/friends/pending (uses $lookup), /api/stats.

/api/users/{user_id}/profile.data_shape: {user_id, name, username, picture, bio, location, is_premium, points, friendship_status, friendship_id, is_own_profile, stats: {total_visits, countries_visited, continents_visited, friends_count}, recent_visits: [{visit_id, landmark_id, landmark_name, visited_at, photo_url}]}

/api/users/search?q=X.data_shape: [{user_id, name, username, picture, bio}] - excludes self, empty for <2 chars

/api/friends/{id}/reject.notes: Returns 404 for invalid friendship_id, deletes friendship document

DELETE /api/friends/{id}.notes: Returns 404 for invalid friendship_id, removes friend

/api/messages/conversations.data_shape: [{friend: {user_id, name, picture, username}, last_message, last_message_time, unread_count}] - premium only

PUT /api/visits/{visit_id}/privacy.data_shape: {message, visibility} - validates public/friends/private, updates visits and activities

/api/leaderboard.notes: Entries have user_id for profile navigation
